gloss: to switch over; to change over; to be switched

definitions.gloss: to switch over; to change over (to a new state or mode)
definitions.explanation: For a system, display, signal, or mode to change from one state to another. The intransitive counterpart of {切|き}り{替|か}える; the change happens by itself or automatically rather than being done to an object.

examples.japanese: ⟦{画面|がめん}→画面：04406_gamen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{切|き}り{替|か}わった。
⟦{信号|しんごう}→信号：03258_shingou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{青|あお}→青：02841_ao⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{切|き}り{替|か}わる。
examples.english: The traffic light changes to green.

examples.japanese: ⟦{四月|しがつ}→四月：00668_shigatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{自動的|じどうてき}→自動的：25589_jidouteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧⟦プラン→プラン：00345_puran⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{切|き}り{替|か}わる。
examples.english: When April comes, it automatically switches over to the new rate plan.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
- Intransitive (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧).
- Pair: ⟦{切|き}り{替|か}える→切り替える：04239_kirikaeru⟧ (transitive — to switch something over).
- Pattern: X⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧(Y⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧){切|き}り{替|か}わる

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{画面|がめん}→画面：04406_gamen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{切|き}り{替|か}わる: the screen changes
- ⟦{自動|じどう}→自動：03339_jidou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{切|き}り{替|か}わる: switches automatically
- ⟦{表示|ひょうじ}→表示：03143_hyouji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{切|き}り{替|か}わる: the display changes over
